title: Telescopes & Observatories
tagline: Ways we learned to see further.
source: Generated from “Timeline of telescopes, observatories, and observing technology” on Wikipedia; each event links to its source article.

events.title: Astrolabe
events.text: 150 BCE, Astrolabe invented by Apollonius of Perga

events.title: Tang dynasty
events.text: Tang dynasty-Song dynasty, observatories built in Chang'an, Kaifeng, Hangzhou, China

events.title: Planisphere
events.text: 11th century – Planisphere invented by Biruni

events.title: Jabir ibn Aflah
events.text: Jabir ibn Aflah develops instruments resembling and perhaps inspiring the torquetum, an observational instrument and mechanical analog computer device

events.title: Oradea
events.text: Observatory at Nagyvarad Oradea, Kingdom of Hungary for Matthias Corvinus. Tabula Varadensis.

events.title: Uraniborg
events.text: Royal Danish Astronomical Observatory Uraniborg at Ven by Tycho Brahe

events.title: Jan Hevelius
events.text: Danzig/Gdansk observatory of Jan Hevelius

events.title: Niccolò Zucchi
events.text: Niccolò Zucchi experiments with a reflecting telescope

events.title: Florence
events.text: Florence Specola observatory

events.title: Short
events.text: Short reflectors used at 63 station network for transit of Venus

events.title: 1836 Swathithirunal opened Trivandrum observatory
events.text: 1836 Swathithirunal opened Trivandrum observatory

events.title: 91cm refracting telescope
events.text: First light of 91cm refracting telescope at Lick Observatory, on Mount Hamilton near San Jose, California

events.title: Kirchhoff
events.text: Kirchhoff and Bunsen develop spectroscopy

events.title: Carnegie Institution
events.text: Observatories of the Carnegie Institution of Washington founded

events.title: Bernard-Ferdinand Lyot
events.text: Bernard-Ferdinand Lyot invents the Lyot filter

events.title: Martin Ryle
events.text: Martin Ryle and his group perform the first astronomical observations with a radio interferometer

events.title: Luoxue Mountain Cosmic Rays Research Center
events.text: Luoxue Mountain Cosmic Rays Research Center, Yunnan Province, in China founded

references.label: Luoxue Mountain Cosmic Rays Research Center

events.title: VLBI
events.text: First VLBI images, with 183 km baseline

events.title: Owens Valley
events.text: Owens Valley 27-meter radio telescopes begin operation, located in Big Pine, California

events.title: Canada-France-Hawaii
events.text: Canada-France-Hawaii optical reflecting telescope begins operation, located at Mauna Kea Observatory, Hawaii

events.title: NASA Infrared Telescope Facility
events.text: NASA Infrared Telescope Facility infrared reflecting telescope begins operation, located at Mauna Kea, Hawaii

events.title: VLA
events.text: Completion of construction of the VLA, located in Socorro, New Mexico

events.title: Cambridge Optical Aperture Synthesis Telescope (COAST)
events.text: Cambridge Optical Aperture Synthesis Telescope (COAST)—the first very high resolution optical astronomical images (from aperture synthesis observations)

events.title: HALCA
events.text: The Japanese HALCA satellite begins operations, producing first VLBI observations from space, 25,000 km maximum baseline

events.title: SALT
events.text: First light at SALT, the largest optical telescope in the Southern Hemisphere, with a hexagonal primary mirror of 11.1 by 9.8 meters.

events.title: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope
events.text: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, part of NASA's Exoplanet Exploration Program. Launch is tentatively scheduled for 2027.
